name: frontend-slides
description: Create stunning, animation-rich HTML presentations from scratch or by converting PowerPoint files. Use when the user wants to build a presentation, convert a PPT/PPTX to web, or create slides for a talk/pitch, and whenever a deck should follow the Recordly house brand — Recordly's own 2026 design system ships as the default style. Helps non-designers discover their aesthetic through visual exploration rather than abstract choices.
